name: GS1 Digital Link Standard, URI Syntax 1.7.0
status: Release 1.7.0 ratified August 2026; the archive on ref.gs1.org lists "Published 7 August 2026".
relevance: The syntax "distinguishes between primary identification keys that express simple GS1 identifiers, such as GTIN and GLN" and key qualifiers and attributes; a GS1 Digital Link URI "is a particular form of URL".

evidence.read: The URI Syntax standard page and its archive on ref.gs1.org, read 2026-10-03 and again 2026-10-13 ("Release 1.7.0, Ratified Aug 2026"; archive: "Published 7 August 2026").
